title: Better coordinate records
description: Press c to display coordinates按下c鍵可以顯示座標
body:
C Key Coordinate Copy
📌 Description (English)

This mod allows players to copy their current coordinates by pressing the C key.

When the player presses C, their current XYZ coordinates are instantly copied to the clipboard. This makes it easy to share locations with friends, save important spots, or paste coordinates into commands.

✨ Features

Press C to copy your current coordinates

Automatically copies full XYZ format

Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

Lightweight and does not affect performance

Client-side only (no server installation required)

🎯 Why download this mod?

Sharing coordinates normally requires typing commands manually. This mod simplifies the process and saves time, especially when building, exploring, or playing on servers with friends.

⚠ Important Information

Default key: C

The keybind can be changed in Minecraft Controls settings

This mod does not provide any unfair advantage

It does not modify gameplay mechanics

It does not send data to any external servers

C鍵複製座標
📌 說明（中文）

本模組允許玩家按下 C 鍵，即可自動複製目前所在位置的 XYZ 座標。

當玩家按下 C 鍵時，系統會將目前座標直接複製到剪貼簿，方便貼到聊天欄、指令、筆記或分享給朋友。

✨ 功能特色

按 C 鍵立即複製當前座標

自動複製完整 XYZ 格式

支援單人與多人模式

輕量化設計，不影響效能

僅需客戶端安裝（伺服器不需要安裝）

🎯 為什麼要下載？

平常需要使用指令才能查看或手動輸入座標，這個模組讓操作更快速、更方便，特別適合：

建築玩家

探險玩家

與朋友分享地點

伺服器遊玩時快速傳送用

⚠ 重要資訊

預設快捷鍵：C（可在控制設定中更改）

不包含作弊功能

不改變遊戲平衡

不會上傳任何資料到外部伺服器
